slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
The midpoint M of segment AB is the point between A and B with AM = MB.

On a number line, the midpoint of a and b is (a + b)/2. In the coordinate plane, the midpoint of (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) is ((x1 + x2)/2, (y1 + y2)/2).

Friends at (1, 2) and (7, 6) meet fairly at (4, 4): average the x-coordinates and average the y-coordinates.
